college.name: Apex Institute of Technology & Sciences
college.motto: Excellence in Innovation, Integrity in Leadership
college.accreditation: NAAC 'A++' Grade • NBA Accredited • NIRF Top Ranked

orientation.overview: The 1-week Fresher Induction & Orientation Program welcomes all newly joined students. You will meet department deans, faculty mentors, club leads, and get your ID card and lab logins.
documents_needed: Government Photo ID (Aadhaar / Passport / Voter ID)
Anti-ragging affidavit (signed by student and parent via antiragging.in)
first_week_milestones: Day 2: Department Orientation & Faculty Advisor introduction
Day 3: Student ID Card issuance & Biometric registration
Day 4: Campus Wi-Fi & LMS (Canvas/Moodle) portal credentials setup

academics.grading_system: 10-point CGPA scale (Cumulative Grade Point Average). Grades range from O (Outstanding - 10) down to F (Fail - 0).
academics.cgpa_formula: SGPA = Sum(Course Credits * Grade Points) / Total Semester Credits. CGPA is the weighted average of all semesters.
academics.attendance_rule: Minimum 75% attendance is strictly mandatory in every subject to appear for end-semester exams. 65%-74% requires medical board approval.
academics.evaluation_breakdown: 40% Continuous Internal Assessment (2 Mid-term tests, assignments, quizzes) + 60% End-Semester Examination.
academics.credit_structure: Average 20-24 credits per semester. A 4-credit course typically involves 3 lecture hours + 1 tutorial/lab hour per week.

campus_facilities.central_library: Open 8:00 AM to 11:00 PM (24x7 during exams). Access to over 150,000 books, IEEE/Springer digital journals, and silent reading cubicles.
campus_facilities.computer_center: High-performance computing labs, 1 Gbps high-speed Wi-Fi across campus, cloud development access.
campus_facilities.cafeteria_and_mess: Central Food Court, 3 satellite canteens, hygienic mess with South Indian, North Indian, and continental meal options.
campus_facilities.health_center: 24/7 on-campus clinic with resident doctor, 2 nursing staff, basic pharmacy, and ambulance service.
campus_facilities.sports_complex: Olympic-sized track, indoor badminton & basketball courts, cricket ground, gymnasium, and swimming pool.

hostel_life.curfew_timings: First-year hostel gates close at 9:00 PM on weekdays, 9:30 PM on weekends. Late entry requires prior warden gate pass.
hostel_life.amenities: High-speed Wi-Fi, 24/7 power backup, RO purified drinking water, hot water geysers, laundromat service, recreation room with TT and TV.
packing_essentials: Bed linen (mattress cover, bedsheets, pillow, light blanket)
Bucket, mug, toiletries, laundry bag, hangers
Extension power strip with surge protection
Personal medical kit with basic medicines
Formal attire for presentations & traditional wear for festivals
Padlocks with duplicate keys for wardrobe and room

clubs_and_societies.name: The Debating Society & MUN

clubs_and_societies.name: NSS & Rotaract Club
clubs_and_societies.description: Community outreach, blood donation camps, environmental drives, and social leadership.

first_year_guide.anti_ragging_policy: Zero-tolerance policy towards any form of ragging. Ragging is a criminal offense punishable under law. The campus is monitored by CCTV and anti-ragging flying squads. Students can report any incident confidentially 24x7 without fear.

faq_quick_answers.a: You must maintain at least 75% attendance in both lectures and practical labs for every registered course. Falling below 75% without authorized medical leave leads to detention from end-semester examinations.

faq_quick_answers.q: How does the CGPA system work?
faq_quick_answers.a: CGPA is calculated on a 10-point scale based on credit hours and grade points. Aim for an 8.0+ CGPA right from Semester 1, as 1st year subjects form the bedrock of your overall cumulative score!

faq_quick_answers.q: How do I get my College ID Card and Wi-Fi access?
faq_quick_answers.a: ID cards are photographed and issued on Day 3 of Orientation at the Student Affairs Center. Wi-Fi credentials (username/password) are sent to your registered student email after biometric verification.

faq_quick_answers.q: What should freshers pack for the hostel?
faq_quick_answers.a: Bring bedsheets, pillow, blanket, bucket & mug, extension cord, umbrella, basic medicines, padlocks with keys, formal attire for college functions, and essential personal toiletries.

faq_quick_answers.q: How can I join college clubs and societies?
faq_quick_answers.a: During the Club Fair in the first week, every club hosts interactive booths. You can register for beginner auditions, introductory workshops, and fresher hackathons—no prior expertise is required!

faq_quick_answers.q: What should I do if I face ragging or bullying?
faq_quick_answers.a: Immediately report to the Campus Anti-Ragging Committee at +91 80-2345-6799 or the National 24x7 Toll-Free Helpline at 1800-180-5522. Every report is strictly confidential and acted upon instantly.
